verdict.rationale: Brex documents a webhooks API: you register an endpoint URL through the register-webhook endpoint and choose which webhook events it receives. The docs also give an example event (a referral activating), so a programmatic consumer can subscribe to outbound HTTP callbacks. Missing for 10: a documented catalog of available event types beyond the referral example, signature verification and retry/delivery-guarantee details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
